1 .  This application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.134/2016 registered at Police Station - Gharghoda, District Raigarh (C.G.) for commission of the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376/34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 & 6 of POCSO Act.

2. Prosecution story, in brief, is that mother of the prosecutrix lodged a written report at Police Station Gharghoda alleging therein that the applicant and other co-accused persons, alluring the her daughter (victim/prosecutrix) took her away with them and on 24.05.2016 he kept her in his house for one day and committed forcible sexual intercourse.
Thereafter, when the news spread in the village, the applicant handed over the prosecutrix to his JCB Driver and also went with them to Gharghoda bus stand.
Based on this, the FIR has been registered against the applicant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.

He further submits that the name of the present applicant does not find place either in FIR, Charge-sheet or supplementary charge-sheet and only on the basis of incident which took place in the year 2016 and in the statement of prosecutrix his name was taken,
the police is threatening the applicant.
He also submits that the main allegation is against co-accused Komal Sidar, who has been acquitted by the Court below vide order dated 20.03.2017 passed in POCSO Case No.61/2016.
He also submits that there is no direct or indirect role of the present applicant in the commission of crime.
Thus, considering the aforesaid factual aspect of the matter, the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the anticipatory bail application.
5. Despite service of notice, no one appeared for complainant/victim.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having considered the fact that the main allegation is against co-accused Komal Sidar, who subsequently acquitted by the Court below vide order dated 20.03.2017 passed in POCSO Case No.61/2016, without further commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
7. Accordingly, the application is allowed.

Sd/-
 (Rajani Dubey)
